title: LSC feature -> tier map
description: PRD premium-tiers FR-MAP-01/04. The root schema validates the `TierAuthorization` configuration section of the API Gateway (appsettings.json / environment variables). `$defs/FeatureMapDocument` validates the public projection served at GET /api/v1/features and the app's embedded fallback copy. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in `x-lsc-semantic-rules` and MUST be enforced by `TierAuthorizationOptionsValidator` (IValidateOptions, ValidateOnStart) in LSC.Authorization.Tiers.

EnforcementMode.description: Enforce = deny with 403 (default). AuditOnly = evaluate, log and count `gateway_tier_denied_total{mode="audit"}` but allow. AuditOnly exists only for the rollout window before the app version with the local scoring mode is adopted; it is refused in Production unless `AllowAuditOnlyInProduction` is true.

ClockSkewSeconds.description: Tolerance applied to the `tier_exp` claim (PRD FR-ENT-04).

AdminBypass.description: When true, a token with claim admin == true passes every tier check (PRD FR-MAP-03 implies admins are never locked out).

Tiers.description: Tier name -> rank. Ranks MUST be unique. The tier with the lowest rank is the default tier for users without a valid claim.

Features.description: Feature key -> minimum tier name. Every value MUST be a key of `Tiers`.

Routes.description: Gated entry routes. Only these are tier-checked (PRD FR-MAP-02). Every `Feature` MUST be a key of `Features`.

PathPattern.description: ASP.NET Core route template matched case-insensitively against the request path with TemplateMatcher (trailing slash tolerant). Use `v{version}` so every API version is covered, e.g. `/api/v{version}/sessions/{sessionId}/devices`.

FeatureMapDocument.title: Public feature map (GET /api/v1/features, app embedded copy)

x-lsc-semantic-rules: S1: Tier ranks are unique (fail startup).
S2: Every Features value is a key of Tiers (fail startup).
S3: Every Routes[].Feature is a key of Features (fail startup).
S4: Every Routes[].PathPattern parses as a route template (fail startup).
S5: No two Routes entries have the same Method and equivalent PathPattern (fail startup).
S6: At runtime a route whose feature cannot be resolved is denied for everyone except admin and logged at Error (PRD FR-MAP-03).
S7: Clients treat unknown feature keys as locked and unknown tiers as the default tier.
